messages:
Liam: Quick econ snapshot from the bring-up sweep: compared orion-14b-int6 vs vela-9b-int4 across two GTN slices (rerank + longform summarization). Posting topline numbers and a routing proposal.
Anya: Nice. Which slice sizes / n? :eyes:
Liam: n=1.5k for rerank (MRR@10), n=1k for summarization (ROUGE-L). Median numbers below: 
- Orion-14b-fp16: rerank MRR@10 0.783, summary ROUGE-L 58.9, cost $0.0275/1k tokens, p95 latency baseline
- Orion-14b-int6: rerank 0.774 (-1.1%), summary 57.1 (-3.1), cost $0.0172/1k (-37%), p95 +12ms
- Vela-9b-int4: rerank 0.760 (-2.9 vs fp16), summary 56.4 (-4.3 vs fp16), cost $0.0101/1k (-63%), p95 +5ms
Remy: So vela is much cheaper but has larger quality drop on summary. For rerank it's closer but still behind. Any per-slice variance?
Liam: Yes; rerank slice variance shows orion-int6 holds up much better on enterprise docs (longer context), vela-int4 drops more on noisy query logs. Summarization: vela-int4 degradation concentrated on multi-paragraph inputs.
Olga: Product ask: we'd accept up to 3% MRR drop on low-priority endpoints, but not for core search.
Anya: My read: hybrid routing by input length + endpoint priority. Keep orion (int6) for long-context or critical endpoints; use vela-int4 for short non-critical cheap paths. Also keep a 5% fp16 holdback to monitor drift.
Liam: Example routing rule we tested:
```
routes:
  - match: {endpoint: '/search', priority: 'core'}
    model: orion-14b-int6
  - match: {endpoint: '/search', priority: 'low'}
    model: vela-9b-int4
  - match: {endpoint: '/summarize', input_tokens: '>1024'}
    model: orion-14b-int6
  - match: {endpoint: '/summarize', input_tokens: '<=1024'}
    model: vela-9b-int4
  - holdback: 5% -> orion-14b-fp16
```
Remy: Suggested rollout: 2% vela -> low-priority search for 48h, 1% vela on summarize short-context canary. Monitor MRR and ROUGE per-slice with alerts at >1.5% drop for rerank and >1.0 ROUGE-L for summaries.
Olga: Can we get absolute cost delta for expected traffic? If GTN does ~12M tokens/day on search, switching low-priority 30% to vela would save roughly: 12M * 30% * ($0.0275 - $0.0101)/1000 = ~$62/day. Can ops verify?
devops-bot: created ticket INF-2129: canary rollout/vitals (owner: remy)
Anya: I'll prepare a short scorecard to share with PMs. Scorecard bullets: 
- Win: vela-int4 cuts unit cost ~63% vs fp16, ~41% vs orion-int6.
- Risk: vela quality hit concentrated on multi-paragraph summarization and noisy queries.
- Recommended default: orion-14b-int6 for critical/long-context routes; vela-9b-int4 for short/non-critical; 5% fp16 holdback + 2% vela canary on low-priority search.
Liam: I'll upload the per-slice charts to the eval dashboard and tag infra for perf counters. Thanks all.
